policy.network: Public HTTPS API/raw allowlist only; DNS checked for public addresses on every request/redirect.
policy.selection: Explicit files only, immutable commit URLs, no archives/clones, no upstream execution.
policy.scope: Original summaries/guidance/examples; actual upstream license text and small source-only selections.
policy.original_content: Original inline examples and editorial guidance dedicated under CC0-1.0; upstream files retain their recorded licenses.

constraints: Restrictive galleries: factual metadata only; no screenshot, article, template, proprietary prompt or skill copied.

Chatterbox/faster-whisper/OpenCut: license evidence only; no weights, audio, dependencies or application mirror.
p5: small unmodified LGPL source references, actual license retained; not a MIT relicense.
OGL: actual README license evidence retained; no invented LICENSE file.
Archived source snippets can refer to unavailable dependencies; never claimed to be standalone executable examples.
